observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher demonstrates movement exercises step-by-step in front of a mirror while explaining technique. He combines spoken instruction with counts and musical accompaniment to guide students through posture and movement.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces the first exercise for arms.
The teacher practices the arm exercise with music.
The teacher breaks down the foot and arm exercise.
The teacher practices the foot exercise with music.
The teacher breaks down the next exercise for plié and upper body curve.

common_mistakes: not stretching knees all the way

steps_taught.name: First exercise arms
steps_taught.description: Arm movements with side bends and chest curls.

steps_taught.name: Foot exercise
steps_taught.description: Foot pointing and plié with arm reaches.

what_hinders: Lacks verbal breakdown for some transitions

quotes.text: Okay, the first exercise is arms up.
And then we do the other side.
Next exercise is for the feet.

evidence_segments.observation: The teacher raises arms to first position and side bends to the right.

extraction.distinctive_method: Combining vocal singing along with live musical accompaniment while demonstrating exercises in front of a mirror.
